summary: Standards-axis review of wave-3 lane-10's full diff (ffe63a0dd08..HEAD): #1015 (rollback-preflight document-lane scoping fix), #1016 (freeze-verifier test's own expected-count fix), #1018 (one shared local-db-gate.mjs replacing 23 drivers' duplicated inline safety gates), #1023 (three new CI legs for previously-uncovered reset-gated upgrade drills), #1028 (the LEG 4 third-race fix in intake-batch-e2e.mjs). Every gate the per-ticket reports claim was independently re-run on this rig and matched: local-db-gate.test.mjs + local-db-gate-drivers-census.test.mjs (14 combined pass), reset-gate-routing.test.mjs's 3 new #1023 cells (8/8), operation-census.test.mjs + rig-isolation.test.mjs with no reset flags (32 pass/1 expected skip), CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true pnpm lint (exit 0, world-gate selftest: OK, db-live-gates/action.yml untouched by this lane so its wiring guard is unaffected), pnpm typecheck (clean), check-frozen-workflows.mjs (OK, 312 files, no manifest diff) and check-parts-parity.mjs (OK). Spot-diffed 5 of the 23 converted e2e drivers (work-journal, intake-batch, trade-invoice, chat-turn-v19, plus the shared module itself) against their pre-#1018 originals: every composed allowedDbPattern/checkDsnString/checkDsnParsed call reproduces the original regex body and DSN-check selection exactly, including drivers whose original DSN check used hostname MEMBERSHIP rather than PGHOST equality (preserved, not tightened). No migration, no PRD/ARCHITECTURE edit, no shared-file (WORK-ORDER rule 7) touched, every commit carries the required Co-Authored-By trailer and a ticket-named type(scope) subject. #1018's driver-conversion commits genuinely grow the census DRIVERS list in step with each commit's converted files (0->4->12->15->20->23, matching each commit's own message), so this is vertical slicing at file-conversion granularity, not the horizontal-slicing anti-pattern WORK-ORDER rule 4 and tdd/SKILL.md forbid. #1023's new cells are text-level structural checks of the CI YAML (no execution), the same house shape #845's own pre-existing cells in the same file already use, which is the sanctioned structural-cell exception to /tdd's seam preference. #1028's fix is precise: the disjointness check now branches on whether a live child remains rather than on timing, the refusal-counting/attribution assertions it must not weaken are untouched and run before it, and the new CLARA_P636_LEG4_FAULT=engine_wins knob reproduces the exact race deterministically (verified by reading the diff and the commit's own measured red/green pair). One real, checkable defect found, in the #1018 per-ticket report's own evidence rather than in the shipped code: its AC1 evidence and its 'Gates, with counts' table both state 'local-db-gate.test.mjs -> 14/14 pass' (and 'no18 unit + 4 census = 18/18' combined with the census file), but the file has 10 top-level test() cases, independently re-run here as 10/10; combined with the census file's 4, the true total is 14, not 18. AGENTS.md rule 6 ('Claims need evidence... No evidence, no claim') is not satisfied by evidence that is itself wrong, even though every other counted claim in this lane's reports was independently re-run here and matched exactly.

findings.title: The #1018 ticket report overstates local-db-gate.test.mjs's own test count (claims 14/14, actual 10/10), so the combined 'gates, with counts' total is also wrong (18/18 claimed, 14 actual)
findings.evidence: docs/plan/active/riders-2026-09-20/reports/wave3-lane10-ticket1018.md, AC1: 'Evidence: node --test packages/runtime/tests/local-db-gate.test.mjs -> 14/14 pass.' The same report's 'Gates, with counts' table: 'touched test files (unit + census) | node --test tests/local-db-gate.test.mjs tests/local-db-gate-drivers-census.test.mjs (from packages/runtime) | 18/18 pass, 0 fail (14 unit + 4 census)'. Re-run on this rig: `node --test tests/local-db-gate.test.mjs` from packages/runtime -> `# tests 10 / # pass 10 / # fail 0`; `node --test tests/local-db-gate-drivers-census.test.mjs` -> `# tests 4 / # pass 4`; the two files together -> `# tests 14 / # pass 14`. Independently confirmed by counting top-level `test(` declarations in packages/runtime/tests/local-db-gate.test.mjs: exactly 10 (isLoopbackHost, allowedDbPattern x2, assertLocalDbGate x4, checkDsnString, checkDsnParsed, both-DSN-together, intake-e2e's-historical-set). AGENTS.md rule 6: 'Any statement about the state of the world... must be backed by a checkable source: a file path, a commit, a test or command run, or a link... If you cannot point to a source, say "unverified" instead of asserting. No evidence, no claim.' The command cited IS checkable, and running it exactly as written does not reproduce the claimed number.
findings.required_fix: Correct the two count claims in reports/wave3-lane10-ticket1018.md (AC1's evidence line and the gates table) to 10/10 for local-db-gate.test.mjs alone and 14/14 for the two files combined. No code or test change is needed: every underlying test genuinely passes; only the report's own arithmetic is wrong.
